## Report

**Phase 1 (ABC-1256) is done.** It is committed and pushed on `hp/admin-rebuild/t-0002-members-admin-users` (4f2a9c1). No PR is open; I'm waiting for your go-ahead.

### What was built
- `/admin/users` on the new page shell: a title, an "Add member" button, a filter row (search, team, role, status) and a sort menu.
- One row per member: name, team, role badge and a ⋮ menu.
- Filters and sort live in the URL, so a view survives reload and can be shared.
- The filter and sort logic is a plain module covered by 15 unit tests.

### Checks
- Passing: typecheck, lint and unit tests.
- Screenshots are in `library/`: `01-overview`, `02-sort-menu`, `03-row-menu`.

### Where this deviates from Figma
1. Each row shows the username only; the list API has no display name yet.
2. An extra "Status" filter keeps the old page's active/inactive behaviour.

### Phase 2 sizing (not started)
- ABC-1250, team-scoped permissions: backend plus a migration, about 3–5 days.
- ABC-1257, create / move / remove: mostly frontend, plus one product decision on what "Remove member" does.
